finding: Broker conflict decisions, compose-vs-serialize decisions, parallel-entry admission, and conflict-resolution correctness are not yet first-class telemetry observations in the coverage summary.
expectedBehavior: Telemetry should record broker decision inputs/outcomes, whether agents were allowed to enter parallel work before conflict analysis, whether writes could be composed, and whether the resolution later proved correct or caused rework.
evidenceOrRepro: The historical report lacked broker outcome samples. Current source now provides the canonical `atm.brokerDecisionObservation.v1` / outcome telemetry seam; `broker-decision-outcome-telemetry.test.ts` and `validate-broker-decision-outcome-telemetry.ts` pass, covering decision class, conflict set, parallel admission, compose/queue outcomes, wait time, rework/escaped conflict, owner override, and outcomeRef joins.
followUp: Keep outcomeRef joins mandatory in future coverage reports. A separate product-evidence task is required before treating live production samples as a performance or correctness claim.
